name: Bas
site: o2.de · Mobile and home internet, Germany
headline: Turn o2’s usage data into tariffs that stay.
saw: Your homepage sells unlimited deals, smartphone contracts and home internet from 19,99 € a month to every visitor the same way, whether they come for the iPhone 17 Pro or the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra.

Once customers are logged in, what they use, when prepaid customers top up and which add-ons they never touch is the strongest signal you own. Today that signal sits in analytics, not in the message they receive.
Cross-sell, upsell and retention campaigns are built by hand, per segment, per month. A prepaid customer about to leave this week gets the same offer as everyone else, or none at all.
help_intro: Three places where an AI that decides per customer, not per segment, pays for itself in the first quarter.

cases.head: Stop the cancellation before it happens
cases.text: Churn signals per customer from usage, top-ups and contract end dates. The right offer, channel and moment, picked for each prepaid and postpaid customer and tested continuously.
cases.kpi_label: lower churn, measured at Flytxt telecom clients

cases.head: Offer the right upgrade per customer
cases.text: Next best tariff, smartphone or home internet offer per customer, based on what they actually use. Family bundle holders stop getting the same upgrade mail as everyone else.
cases.kpi_label: category subscriptions at an OTT client

cases.head: Keep every customer using the plan
cases.text: Personal streaming, TV and data bundle nudges per customer, so every customer finds a reason to use what they pay for. Delivered by email and on your site.
cases.kpi_label: streaming activity at an OTT client
